info.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol X1 MK2
info.author: infiniteloop
info.description: HID mapping for the Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol X1 Mk2 (USB 17cc:1220). Shift is the top-left Shift button. This is not compatible with the X1 Mk1 MIDI mapping.

option.label: Log raw HID reports
option.description: Write every input report to the Mixxx log as one line starting with X1MK2_HID_REPORT, followed by the report length and the bytes in hexadecimal. Turn this on while pressing each control once, then search the log for X1MK2_HID_REPORT. On Android the same lines are in logcat (tag qt or mixxx) and in Mixxx's log file.
